pages.en: One hot morning, Mum opens the fridge. The milk is warm and the light does not come on. "Oh no! The fridge is broken," she says.
pages.zh: 一个炎热的早上，妈妈打开冰箱。牛奶是温的，灯也不亮。“哎呀！冰箱坏了，”她说。
pages.scene: A sunny kitchen in the morning, Mum looking into an open fridge with no light inside, holding a bottle of milk, Lily and Tom watching from the table.

pages.en: Dad looks at the lamp and the radio. Nothing works! "There is no electricity in the house," he says.
pages.zh: 爸爸看了看台灯和收音机。都不工作！“家里停电了，”他说。
pages.scene: Dad in the kitchen trying the switch of a dark lamp, a silent radio on the shelf, Max sitting next to him looking curious.

pages.en: Lily and Tom put the food in a cool bag. At lunchtime the lights come on again, and the fridge works again. "Yes!" shouts Tom.
pages.zh: Lily 和 Tom 把食物放进保温袋。到了中午，灯又亮了，冰箱也重新工作了。“太好了！”Tom 大喊。
pages.scene: The kitchen with all the lights back on, the fridge humming with a soft glow inside, Tom jumping with his arms up, Lily laughing, Max wagging his tail.

questions.q: The fridge is broken because there is no electricity.
questions.zh: 冰箱坏了，是因为停电了。

questions.q: What does Dad look at first?
The lights come on again in the evening.
